# Confluence-jjs 5.0.194

This is a stability-focused release based on the device-tested 5.0.194 skin state.

## Highlights

- Home artwork state now remains stable when leaving and returning to the Home screen, including video browsing and library/scanner activity.
- Artwork geometry is no longer rebuilt just because another window was opened; updates are limited to actual title or layout changes.
- Large Front + Back artwork uses the visible artwork widths, improving spacing for non-square and longbox covers.
- If a new title has no back cover, the selected layout size is preserved and only the unavailable back cover is dropped.
- Song Popup track selection no longer raises the previous Busy overlay or temporarily removes the visible highlight.
- Arbitrary Song Popup selections now use Kodi's relative playlist offset correctly, so the highlighted track and the track that starts playing stay in sync.
- The immediate Stop behavior and the other Song Popup stability fixes from the test series are retained.
- The experimental credit-glyph suppression code was removed because it did not solve the remaining special-character rendering issue.

## Installation

Download `skin.confluence.custom-5.0.194.zip` from the release assets and install it in Kodi via **Add-ons -> Install from zip file**.

This version was device-tested before publication.
